glosses: to fog, become covered with mist

examples.text: De weervrouw had gezegd dat het zou gaan misten, maar we misten dat door de mist.
examples.translation: The weatherwoman had said that it would become foggy, but we missed that on account of the mist.
examples.english: The weatherwoman had said that it would become foggy, but we missed that on account of the mist.

glosses: meervoud van het zelfstandig naamwoord mist
het heersen van slecht zicht door de aanwezigheid van laaghangende bewolking

examples.text: Het mistte vreselijk en de automobilisten moesten snelheid minderen.

glosses: Obscured by mist or fog; unclear; hazy.

examples.text: At Esher we were getting out into bright sunshine, and apart from another foggy patch between Farnborough and Winchfield, we had a clear run from then on.
He was still foggy with sleep.
If she knew [a psychiatrist was] observing her son with a view to finding out if he was foggy between the ears, there would be umbrage on her part, or even dudgeon.

glosses: Being, covered with, or pertaining to fog (“tall grass etc that grows after, or is left after, cutting; moss”)

examples.text: For they will feed on foggy grass and such like. Also ye shall understand that horses and Cattel may not well be foddered in Winter all together, but […]
[…] for as he shuts up his meadow at Christmas, leaves such foggy grass behind, and manures well, in case a wet hot summer succeeds, […]
See swingin' owr the foggy swaird, Begrac'd wi' angel features, […]
